title: VIP Chapter 3 Week 3: Rift Valley and Impacts of Relief

questions.text: The Afar Triangle is a TRIPLE JUNCTION where which plates meet?
questions.explanation: Afar = where Arabian, Nubian, Somali plates meet.

questions.text: Lake Langano is popular for tourism because it is:
questions.explanation: Lake Langano is safe for swimming (no bilharzia).

questions.text: Which Rift Valley lake is the DEEPEST in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Lake Shalla is the deepest Rift Valley lake (266m).

questions.text: Orographic rainfall in Ethiopia occurs when:
options: A) Wind blows over flat plains
B) Moist air rises over mountains, cools, and rains
questions.correct_answer: B) Moist air rises over mountains, cools, and rains
questions.explanation: Orographic rain = moist air forced up mountains cools and condenses.

questions.text: Which Rift Valley section has the MOST lakes?
questions.explanation: Central Rift has 7 major lakes.

questions.text: The RAIN SHADOW effect causes:
options: A) Leeward slopes to be DRY
B) Windward slopes to be dry
questions.correct_answer: A) Leeward slopes to be DRY
questions.explanation: Rain shadow = dry conditions on leeward side.

questions.text: Ethiopia's hydroelectric potential is DUE TO its:
options: B) High relief and deep river gorges
questions.correct_answer: B) High relief and deep river gorges
questions.explanation: Deep gorges + high elevation = hydropower potential.

questions.text: Afroalpine vegetation is found:
questions.explanation: Afroalpine = giant lobelia on high peaks (Bale, Simien).

questions.text: Terracing in Ethiopian highlands is used to:
options: B) Prevent soil erosion on slopes
questions.correct_answer: B) Prevent soil erosion on slopes
questions.explanation: Terraces = reduce erosion on steep slopes.

questions.text: The Tekeze Dam is built on which river?
questions.explanation: Tekeze Dam on Tekeze River.

questions.text: Gilgel Gibe dams are on the:
questions.explanation: Gilgel Gibe = Omo River basin.

questions.text: Which crops grow at HIGHEST elevation?
questions.explanation: Wheat/barley = high altitude crops.

questions.text: The Chew Bahir Rift is used primarily for:
questions.explanation: Chew Bahir = semi-arid pastoralism.

questions.text: Saline soils in lowlands are caused by:
questions.explanation: High evaporation = salt accumulation.

questions.text: The Awash River flows INTO:
questions.explanation: Awash River ends in Lake Abbe (Afar).

questions.text: Which factor MOST influences settlement patterns in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Elevation/climate determine habitability.

questions.text: The Rift Valley escarpments are:
options: B) Steep fault walls bounding the valley
questions.correct_answer: B) Steep fault walls bounding the valley
questions.explanation: Escarpments = steep fault-bounded walls.

questions.text: Coffee forests are found at:
questions.explanation: Coffee grows best at middle altitudes.

questions.text: Ethiopia's relief creates NATURAL BARRIERS for transportation because of:
options: B) Deep gorges and steep mountains
questions.correct_answer: B) Deep gorges and steep mountains
questions.explanation: Gorges/mountains = transportation challenges.

questions.text: The Omo National Park is in which Rift section?
questions.explanation: Omo NP in southern (Chew Bahir) Rift.
